title: Master Trading Notes: EMA Pullback Strategy
content:
Strategy Name: EMA_Pullback_v1.0 on BTCUSDT 1H timeframe.
Trend: Uptrend when EMA20 > EMA50; Downtrend when EMA20 < EMA50.
Pullback: Candle low touches/pierces EMA20 for long (high for short).
Confirmation: The candle immediately following pullback must close above pullback high and EMA20 for long.
Entry: Enter at the exact OPEN of the next candle following confirmation.
Stop Loss: Placed at pullback candle Low for long (High for short).
Take Profit: Fixed 2.0R target.
Risk: 1% account equity.
Position: Single position, no pyramiding.
Same bar: SL first.

title: ICT Concept Notes
content:
We trade 1H BTCUSDT.
Wait for a liquidity sweep of previous high.
Close above pullback high confirms.
Enter at next open.
Stop loss at pullback low.
Target at 2R.
Risk 1% per trade.
